text:
```yaml
name: E2E Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pnpm install

    - name: Run E2E tests
      run: pnpm test:e2e
```

This workflow file sets up a GitHub Actions job to run end-to-end tests whenever changes are pushed to the `main` branch or when a pull request is opened against the `main` branch. It checks out the code, sets up Node.js, installs dependencies using `pnpm`, and then runs the E2E tests using `pnpm test:e2e`.
